method: Independent source and sealed-evidence audit plus isolated work-copy replay of the 17-condition project fit audit, five declared rigid-body motion conditions, and an adversarial reel sweep including the omitted front-shell detent obstacle.
acceptance: The stand ordinary sweep must clear at 29 samples, both stand endpoint overtravel checks must block at the authored endpoints, and the reel must demonstrate a two-way 73-sample cycle including the functional front detent interaction.
Rabbit home must preserve a measurable 0.25 mm differential against fox and owl with radial entry clearance, and the nose and pockets must have a demonstrable cam-in/cam-out path.
Shell hooks must have a demonstrable insertion path through the receiver as well as a separately verified retained pullout stop.
The deployed stand angle and footprint must agree with the authored brief before endpoint evidence passes.
Digital checks must not be represented as proof of snap force, retention force, tipping, pinch safety, strength, or cycle life.
